g.text: UPDI high level = AVR 5 V supply.

g.desc: UPDI high level = AVR 5 V supply.

g.text: Open-drain TX releases the line for AVR replies.

g.desc: Open-drain TX releases the line for AVR replies.

g.text: R17 = 2k2 for faster UPDI rising edges.

g.desc: R17 = 2k2 for faster UPDI rising edges.

g.text: Keep traces short; check edges at selected baud rate.

g.desc: Keep traces short; check edges at selected baud rate.

g.text: Remove JP1 shunts before using external J4.

g.desc: Remove JP1 shunts before using external J4.

g.text: All 4u7 ceramics: 50 V X7R, 1206; verify DC-bias curves.

g.desc: All 4u7 ceramics: 50 V X7R, 1206; verify DC-bias curves.

g.text: Do not connect USB VBUS to board VCC or VDD.

g.desc: Do not connect USB VBUS to board VCC or VDD.

g.text: FULL-SIZE SD CARD — SHOU HAN C7529393

g.desc: FULL-SIZE SD CARD — SHOU HAN C7529393

g.text: U22: VBUS absent holds U18 in reset.

g.desc: U22: VBUS absent holds U18 in reset.

g.text: 5.5 V tolerant input; Ioff prevents back-powering.

g.desc: 5.5 V tolerant input; Ioff prevents back-powering.

g.text: Keep USB D+/D- short, matched and 90 ohm differential.

g.desc: Keep USB D+/D- short, matched and 90 ohm differential.

g.text: Move both shunts together; do not bridge 1-2 / 3-4 / 5-6.

g.desc: Move both shunts together; do not bridge 1-2 / 3-4 / 5-6.

g.text: B0=TX, B1=RX; UART hardware flow control OFF.

g.desc: B0=TX, B1=RX; UART hardware flow control OFF.

g.text: Remove all three before using external J3.

g.desc: Remove all three before using external J3.

g.text: Program EEPROM over USB with FT_PROG:

g.desc: Program EEPROM over USB with FT_PROG:

g.text: Self-powered; channel A D2XX/MPSSE, B UART/VCP.

g.desc: Self-powered; channel A D2XX/MPSSE, B UART/VCP.

g.text: Set unique serial number. Disable suspend pull-downs.

g.desc: Set unique serial number. Disable suspend pull-downs.

g.text: VBUS detection uses RESET, not the channel-B suspend option.

g.desc: VBUS detection uses RESET, not the channel-B suspend option.

g.text: Self-powered from board 3.3 V. USB and board share ground.

g.desc: Self-powered from board 3.3 V. USB and board share ground.

g.text: USB VBUS is sensed only; it does not power the board.

g.desc: USB VBUS is sensed only; it does not power the board.

g.text: LAYOUT: retain short capacitor returns; check U14 thermal margin

g.desc: LAYOUT: retain short capacitor returns; check U14 thermal margin

g.text: with added FT2232H load. External JTAG and UPDI headers retained.

g.desc: with added FT2232H load. External JTAG and UPDI headers retained.

g.text: J3/J4 reference is board 5 V; do not feed USB power into either header.

g.desc: J3/J4 reference is board 5 V; do not feed USB power into either header.
